note: The A3 stimulus, authored once and read by both gen-a3.js and the Rust harness test. Enables square 0 at duty 50 percent, constant volume 15, length halted, timer 8: the sequencer steps every 2*(8+1) CPU cycles, so sq0_out repeats its 8-step duty pattern every 144 CPU cycles. Hand-assembled; the bytes are the program.
asm: 8005: A9 BF     LDA #$BF   ; duty 10, halt, constant volume 15
800F: A9 00     LDA #$00   ; timer high = 0, load length
